subject.title: fix(agent-tools): add request timeout to remote media fetches

question: Should the five new caller deadlines align with the canonical 15-minute bounded-media ceiling, or is a two-minute total-transfer cap intentionally acceptable for agent-tool and Tlon media?
rationale: A total deadline is an accepted root-cause fix, but its duration changes valid transfer behavior; current history supports 15 minutes while this branch provides no sizing, network, or owner evidence for 2 minutes.

options.title: Align with 15 minutes
options.body: Use the landed bounded-media ceiling, preserve the existing body-idle limits, and add focused stall and slow-progress coverage.

options.title: Approve two minutes
options.body: Retain 120 seconds only with explicit owner acceptance and evidence that supported payload sizes and expected networks complete safely within it.

options.title: Land the seam first
options.body: Separate the optional shared API from caller policy and defer defaults until the timeout duration is approved.

recommendation.title: Align with 15 minutes
recommendation.body: Use the landed bounded-media ceiling, preserve the existing body-idle limits, and add focused stall and slow-progress coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They own recent shared-media history and documented the canonical 15-minute decision for the same total-request-lifetime invariant.
